items.title: New 'devil flower' species discovered in Thai national park
items.summary: Researchers have described a new species of leafless flowering plant found on the forest floor of a national park in western Thailand, and its otherworldly appearance has earned it a fittingly dramatic name: Thismia daemona, the "devil flower."

items.title: Rising Over Louisiana

items.title: Tracking emperor penguins from space
items.summary: For the first time, geographers from Durham University have used freely available satellite radar images to track emperor penguins through the polar winter—giving a year-round view of their movements. items.title: German cities reveal warmer nights in districts with more non-German residents
items.summary: Urban heat adaptation will gain in importance as climate change progresses. Researchers at the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT) have analyzed how sociodemographic factors (nationality, age, and rent) correlate with heat exposure throughout Germany.

items.title: “Broken heart syndrome” can look just like a heart attack. This test can tell them apart
items.summary: “Broken heart syndrome” can mimic a heart attack so closely that patients often need invasive testing to tell the difference.
